trophies.name: Done-zo!
trophies.description: Earn all of The Show™ 17 Trophies.

trophies.name: First, let me catch my breath
trophies.description: Score on an inside the park home run while playing at Polo Grounds. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game or by switching teams.)

trophies.name: Still got it
trophies.description: Win a game in Retro Mode. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, by switching teams, or setting innings to less than 9.)

trophies.name: Straight flexin'
trophies.description: Hit a home run that travels a minimum of 430 ft in Retro Mode. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game or by switching teams.)

trophies.name: Why you heff to be mad?
trophies.description: Strike out your opponent on a no swing strike three. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, by switching teams, or with quick counts turned ON.)

trophies.name: Back in time
trophies.description: Complete a Retro Mode game with the 8-bit filter turned ON. (This trophy is not awarded if completed by using fast forward or setting innings to less than 9.)

trophies.name: Every strike brings me closer...
trophies.description: With the same player, strike out, then hit a home run in their next at bat. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, or by switching teams.)

trophies.name: Secondary position?
trophies.description: With a position player on the mound, strike out a batter.  (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, by switching teams, or with quick counts ON.)

trophies.name: Same name shame
trophies.description: While batting with your pitcher, get a hit against an opposing pitcher who has the same name.  (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, or by switching teams.)

trophies.name: Thou shalt not steal!
trophies.description: On defense, successfully throw out a baserunner that is stealing.  (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, or by switching teams.)

trophies.name: "Our National Pastime All The Time®"
trophies.description: Complete a game while using the MLB Network® broadcast theme style. (This trophy is not awarded if completed by fast forwarding, using quick manage, or setting innings to less than 9.)

trophies.name: Win, Dance, Repeat
trophies.description: Discover a new end of game celebration by winning as the home team on defense in one of eighteen stadiums. (This trophy is not awarded if completed in a local multiplayer game, by switching teams, or fast forwarding.)

trophies.name: Pulling the strings
trophies.description: In Franchise, Season, or Postseason™ modes, complete a Quick Manage game. (This trophy is not awarded if completed by entering the game or simulating a half inning.)

trophies.name: The hot seat
trophies.description: In Franchise/Season, complete a Critical Situation. (This trophy is not awarded if completed by switching teams or using fast forward.)

trophies.name: Buckle up kid
trophies.description: In Franchise/Season, complete a game while using Player Lock. (This trophy is not awarded if completed by switching teams, fast forwarding, or disabling player lock.)

trophies.name: Your journey begins...
trophies.description: Create a new Road To The Show player.

trophies.name: Prepare for takeoff
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, hit a home run while using Show Time.

trophies.name: Haters gonna hate
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, equip your player with a piece of equipment from each rarity type. (Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond)

trophies.name: Show me the money!
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, sign your first MLB®  contract.

trophies.name: Team player
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, accept a position change request.

trophies.name: Sick gainz bro
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, enter into a training session.

trophies.name: <3 Love it <3
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, favorite a social media message.

trophies.name: Road to the me show
trophies.description: In Road To The Show, get sassy with one of your responses.

trophies.name: Welcome back!
trophies.description: Enter into your second Battle Royale draft in Diamond Dynasty.

trophies.name: I'll take that
trophies.description: Conquer and hold 5 different enemy strongholds in Diamond Dynasty Conquest Mode.

trophies.name: Mission complete
trophies.description: Complete one bronze level mission.

trophies.name: Lookin' good
trophies.description: Customize your Universal Profile nameplate and icon.

trophies.name: Just stopping by for now
trophies.description: In Diamond Dynasty, get placed into the Regular Season division in a Head to Head season.

trophies.name: My uniform is cooler
trophies.description: Complete an Extra Innings game in Diamond Dynasty.

trophies.name: Cha-Ching
trophies.description: Purchase an item from the Ticket Counter.

trophies.name: Wait now it's mission complete
trophies.description: Complete one silver level mission.

trophies.name: Participation trophy
trophies.description: In Diamond Dynasty, enter into an Online Event.
